kitDescription: 2B is a Fire AR Defender whose offense scales with how often she personally bursts. Each of her own burst casts permanently raises her Max HP in escalating cumulative steps — 10.03% on the first, adding 20.06% on the second, adding 57.76% on the third, capping at 87.85% total. A passive converts 6.16% of her current (final) Max HP into ATK, so every Max HP stack makes every hit she deals harder; this conversion is her real damage engine. Every 300 rounds she fires, she deals an extra 167.45% of final ATK to the enemy. Her burst fires two instant hits at cast time — a 2439.36% distributed hit against all enemies plus a separate 792% hit against the highest-HP enemy — both landing before the Full Burst window opens.

skill1.explanation: Own-cast keying verified behaviourally by the blind co-B3 counterfactual (re-keying to fullBurstEnter inflates grant count) and by the driver's step-0 count == own burstCast count assertion.

The one S5 over-strict assertion (cumulative must out-damage tier3-only on TOTAL) was a blind-side ramp artifact, reconciled — not a driver divergence.

gotchas.summary: All three damage lines encoded non-crit (flatDamage default); blind S6 encodes crit:true. Structurally the only divergence in the entire gauntlet, documented with a measurement recipe on BOTH sides — but the SSOT leans toward the blind: function/burst damage 'CRIT at the caster's rate (default on)', and the popup-verified Cinderella worked example shows a burst nuke critting (x1.5 pair exact). Non-crit under-credits these hits by ~7.5% expected value if the game crits them.
gotchas.evidence: Kit prose is silent on crit (no contradiction — rule F respected). Formula SSOT damage-type table: skill '% of final ATK' crit ON, burst nuke crit ON; damage-calculation.md 5b crit pair measured. Driver cites helm/exia non-crit precedent + flags it (caveat 3 / note flag2); S6 sets crit:true flagged as an unmeasured reversible prior.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement, not a fudge: focus-2B recording, read popup colours/values on the 167.45% rider and the 2439.36/792 burst hits (a crit popup is exactly x1.5 its non-crit sibling at base crit damage). If crits observed, set crit:true on all three flatDamage lines; if never observed across a full fight, keep the default and close the flag.

verdictRationale: No undocumented divergence exists: all six kit lines are FAITHFUL with byte-identical structural convergence between the driver and the S6 blind override, and the S5 blind suite runs GREEN unmodified apart from two over-strict assertions that were reconciled as blind-side defects (a ramp-sensitive total-damage ordering that is not a property of cumulativity, and an exact teammate-equality demand broken by a 0.03-0.04% second-order sim artifact with identical FB counts) — neither is a driver divergence. The single real residual is the crit encoding on the three damage lines: driver defaults non-crit, blind opts crit:true, both flag it measurement-gated; the formula SSOT's default-on crit for function/burst damage plus the Cinderella popup-verified crit pair lean toward the blind's direction, so this is the one item the owner should resolve with a popup-colour read before locking magnitudes (med severity, documented, not blocking). Two shared-prior conventions survive as the same-family residual the owner should spot-check against footage: the cumulative 87.85% escalation reading (corroborated by the Liter validated precedent but originating from claude-family blind agents) and the recurring-every-300 vs one-time rider reading (both flagged with discriminator recipes). The S1-feeds-conversion coupling, own-burstCast keying, distributed-flavor separation, and FB-exempt cast timing — the four load-bearing claims — are each proven by independent discriminating counterfactuals that fail under their named nearest-wrong models. Verdict GO; the crit measurement is the recommended follow-up, not a gate.
